answer: Mechanism: Violet-Mirror-Marble Locality Attestation. Each identity binds to three independent network beacons—violet, mirror, marble—that sign round-trip latency and clock-skew measurements. Registration needs concurrent low-variance readings from distinct ASNs; periodic re-attestation uses fresh nonces. Sybils must acquire many stable, physically distinct network vantage points, paying ongoing hosting, hardware, and coordination costs; spoofed or cloned signatures collide and are rejected.
